html:
• 对比 · Grok BotOpenMausBot, an open-source Grok Bot-style appThe post describes OpenMausBot, a chat app where every contact is an AI bot (not xAI code, 16.9K GitHub stars): each bot runs on your own Claude, Codex or Grok login with its own cloud Linux desktop or local VM, asks before commands or file edits, reaches 500+ apps via Composio, Apache-2.0; the app is free but models still bill you.itsarcvale2026-11-07
  • 对比 · Grok BotTimon, an open-source alternative that runs agents on your machineThe post introduces Timon (AGPL-3.0), which adds memory, routines, a browser and a dev workspace (terminal, Kanban, Git, Claude Code or Codex) to subscriptions you already pay for. Steps: check requirements, install the desktop package, sign in to an agent CLI, start small. Caveats: AI usage isn’t free, the machine must stay on, don’t expose it publicly, and GrokBot or Hermes exports may not transfer directly.WojakTheDev2026-11-07
  • 对比 · OpenAI Dots12 billion credits for $120: Meta Muse as the best valueThe author says Meta Muse gives 12 billion credits for $120 and is the best AI value he has tried. Grok Bot burns through usage faster, Muse delivers better results for him and also beats ChatGPT Dots; Claude Duet is next on his list.BrianSky2026-11-07
  • 对比 · OpenAI DotsOpenAI Dots vs Claude Duet: what can you actually hand over?Using official descriptions and early-user reports, the video compares one-off, scheduled or event-triggered tasks and ongoing responsibilities; Dots' activity view and browser takeover versus Duet's channels and task management; drafting versus committing; and how to brief an agent. The workshop scenario is illustrative, not a product test.AI for Real Work — by Reasonfold2026-11-07
  • 对比 · Meta Muse90% of personal and work tasks handled with Meta MuseThe author says he does 90% of his personal and work-related tasks with Meta Muse, and the rest with Grok Imagine and ComfyUI.KevinMHeinrich2026-11-07
  • 对比 · Grok BotWhen Grok Bots get amnesia, SuperLedger uses Coda over NotionEveryone reaches for Notion first when Grok Bots wake with amnesia. When ten bots write at once or a team joins, polite prompts break. SuperLedger uses Coda formula verbs plus $0 Free Editors to build a shared brain for about $12/mo.bfrench2026-11-06
  • 对比 · OpenAI DotsLive starting prices for Grok Bot, Dots, Meta Muse and morePersonal AI agents finally have a pricing table that is not a press release. The author put live starting prices for Grok Bot, Dots, Meta Muse, Manus, Lindy, plus open-source OpenClaw and Hermes Agent on one page. Grok Bot from $30/mo; Dots rides ChatGPT plans from $100/mo.Stan_Timek2026-11-06
  • 对比 · 多产品Always-on agent comparison: Claude Duet vs Grok Bot vs ChatGPT Dots vs Meta MuseThe author compares next-generation autonomous agents—Claude Duet, Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots, and Meta Muse—each on dedicated cloud environments for complex ongoing background tasks, and asks which agent is best for which job.sustainme_in2026-11-05
  • 对比 · 多产品Switched from OpenClaw to Grok Bot; no appetite to re-setup Muse or DotsThe author says personal-agent stickiness is high: started on OpenClaw, switched to Grok Bot a couple months ago. Muse and OpenAI Dots look interesting, but they have no interest or time to set everything up again; Grok runs their whole life.lucsucces2026-11-05
  • 对比 · 多产品Likes Grok Bot but wants Dot-like mail triggers and SMSThe author likes Grok Bot but notes missing quick scroll/search in chat and no clear update toast. They want event-trigger automation and SMS; ChatGPT Dot can start a task on new Gmail and recently added limited SMS.0Toole2026-11-05
  • 对比 · Meta MuseTrying Meta Muse: about half of a YouTube workflow, but Grok Bot feels more polishedThe author says Muse could handle roughly half of his YouTube production process, but for now Grok Bot feels more complete; Muse is practical yet still rough in many places. This is post 1 of a 5-part thread on its pros and problems.aaxonn2026-11-04
  • 对比 · Grok BotClaude Code vs Grok Bot: heavy lifting while present vs running after you log offThe author argues it’s not a weak model managing a strong one but a split of roles: Claude Code suits heavy work while you’re there; Grok Bot has its own cloud computer, keeps running after you shut your laptop and is native to X, so it suits watching narratives and running routines. He linked a summary of key points.Smashe__2026-11-04
  • 对比 · 多产品Using Grok Bot and Dots side by side: Dots felt more integrated for his workflowThe author says Dots isn’t as bad as people claim. He has been using both Grok Bot and Dots, and for his own workflow he finds Dots even more integrated.tpenido772026-11-04
  • 对比 · 多产品Duet had too many issues; after Grok Bot’s limit runs out, back to OpenAI dotThe author found Duet had many annoying issues and limitations that Grok Bot does not. Once her Grok Bot usage runs out, she will probably go back to OpenAI dot for a while.aliceisplaying2026-11-04
  • 对比 · Meta MuseSame character, same prompt: Meta Muse vs three image modelsThe author kept the same character image and the exact same prompt and only swapped the image model: Meta Muse, Google Imagen3, Qwen Image 3 and Grok Imagine Image 2.0, with the four results attached.310techlab2026-11-03
  • 对比 · 多产品Dots or Grok Bot: no single winnerA comparison reply from the official Grok account: OpenAI Dots has its own cloud computer, proactive research and deep ties to ChatGPT, Slack, Teams and 4,000+ apps, with one primary agent today. Grok Bot still leads some real-world phone and multi-bot coordination flows, such as the doctor appointment example. The verdict: no single winner, match the tool to your stack and the job.grok2026-11-03
  • 对比 · 多产品Assistant app directories: ChatGPT 8,495, Claude 8,478, Meta Muse 63The author counts 8,495 apps in ChatGPT's directory and 8,478 in Claude's connector directory, with 1,020 and 708 added in the last seven days. Google's store, opened October 30, has 52 and Meta Muse has 63. He sees an early app-store land grab where review speed is the moat; developers report OpenAI approvals in one to two days.stretchcloud2026-11-03
  • 对比 · 多产品Dots or Grok Bot? Dots reaches Europe as limits tightenThe author links this week's melted weekly limits to Grok Bot costing more to serve than it earned. He notes the timing: OpenAI Dots is coming to Europe and chatting with your Dot doesn't count against ChatGPT limits, so many will try it and competition may heat up. For now he finds Grok Bot way ahead but expects Dots to improve fast.Kappaemmedev2026-11-02
  • 对比 · 多产品Choosing between GrokBot, Claude Max and ChatGPT Pro, he picked ChatGPT ProThe author chose ChatGPT Pro at $100. His reasons: Dots, the always-on agent, is still exploratory and similar to GrokBot but doesn't seem to support multiple bots yet; chatting with Dots doesn't eat ChatGPT/Codex weekly usage; there's no 5-hour limit like Claude Max; $100 a month in API credits; frequent usage resets; the subscription works in Hermes Agent; and GPT-6.1 Sol is enough for him, though he admits Opus 5.5 is very good.DedeChandraN2026-11-01
  • 对比 · 多产品Comparing Dot and Muse on a road trip: free-tier Muse surprised himWhile driving, the author tested which agents could handle light work. Between his Dot and his Muse agent, he was shocked at how good Muse is even on the free tier; he says the Dot is great too, while noting it costs $150 a month.TLeeMcD2026-11-01
  • 对比 · 多产品Agent rankings from someone paying for all of themWith 3 Claude Max plans, a $500 Codex plan and a max Grok Bot plan, the author ranks: 1) ChatGPT Dots for elite voice calling, 2) Grok Bot, which would be first but its usage limits force weekly workflows to adapt, 3) Claude Duet.midwit2026-10-31
  • 对比 · 多产品Trying OpenAI Dots, compared with Grok BotThe author liked Dots' idea of an orchestrator of sessions, but says Grok Bot feels more like a team already working than one chat driving tabs. Next they want bots running Claude Code on their own VMs.fmartinezgodoy2026-10-31
  • 对比 · 多产品ChatGPT Dot vs Grok Bot on rework, from real useThe author had Dot make a YouTube video and sent it a full audit. Dot replied 'should I start the rework?' and, 30 minutes later, was still waiting and asked 'should I pause the routine?' (in German, translated by the author). He says Grok Bot simply reworks it when he says it's bad.ST_Automation2026-10-30
  • 对比 · 多产品Choosing among 5 AI personal assistants: Muse, dots, Cue, Grok Bot, TodayThe author went through the pricing pages and public reviews of Muse, dots, Cue, Grok Bot and Today (rechecked on Oct 30) and concludes the features have converged; the differences are in entry points, access to closed platforms, and trust. A comparison table and 48 sources are attached. Disclosure: the author uses Grok Bot.vicyan12252026-10-30
  • 对比 · Grok BotClaire Vo's personal agent bench: Grok Bot first at 93%The post relays Claire Vo's personal agent bench: 4 agents on the same 9 real tasks. Grok Bot placed first at 93%, winning the Figma thumbnail, inbox tasks and shoe shopping; Claude Duet came last at 79%. Coding was Grok Bot's weak spot. Her call: work jobs go to Grok Bot.wesselvk2026-10-30
  • 对比 · 多产品Dots lets you pick a model per task; Grok Bot doesn't yetThe author notes Dots is not unlimited, but you can specify the model: Luna models for menial work, Terra or Sol models with more effort for complex tasks. Grok Bot doesn't let you specify one now. He likes both but leans on his Dot more often.cecil_21m2026-10-30
  • 对比 · 多产品Coordinating coding agents with Dots, Grok Bot and Claude ProjectsThe author tried having Dots steer Codex and called it a nightmare; a custom tunnel MCP letting the Dot drive agents on his Mac via the Paseo MCP worked better than native orchestration but still poorly, because it doesn’t know how to prompt other agents. Grok Bot is better but eats tokens. His best coordinator so far is Claude Projects, still rough in beta, especially permissions.astralwave2026-10-28
  • 对比 · 多产品Choosing between Muse and Grok Bot by how work is organized, not feature listsBased on official material as of 2026-10-28, the author suggests a trial order: start with Meta Muse for personal preferences and life admin, and evaluate Grok Bot first for recurring research, file delivery and explicit responsibilities. Run about ten real tasks and track acceptable deliverables, review minutes, serious errors, recovery and total cost. He stresses it is not a tested ranking.Bagel83432026-10-28
  • 对比 · 多产品A small business owner compares Dot, Muse, Grok Bot and HermesThe author finds OpenAI Dot promising but slow to evolve, and it can't safely drive more than 2 or 3 sessions in parallel; Muse is polished and the most proactive but doesn't feel built for work; his Grok Bot for X was dumb a few times early on and lost his trust; Hermes is good for research and discussing ideas, not doing the work. He is waiting for Claude Duet before picking a daily driver, since setting up an agent takes time.pocarles2026-10-28
  • 对比 · 多产品Muse or Grok Bot: choose by how the work is organisedBased on official material as of 2026-10-28, the author offers a trial order rather than a test verdict: try Meta Muse first for personal errands and goals, and evaluate Grok Bot first for work with clear roles, repeated deliverables and cross-tool collaboration. They warn that Grok Bot bots on one account share a cloud computer, files and login sessions, so role names are not data isolation, while Muse describes an architecture separating the agent environment from security-sensitive services. They suggest running the same 10 tasks twice on each, logging accepted deliverables, review minutes per task, major errors and recovery, plus tests for expired logins and missing sources.Bagel83432026-10-28
  • 对比 · OpenAI DotsFour personal agents tested on 450 everyday tasks eachThe author's team asked whether you would trust a personal agent with your inbox, bills and daily errands, and tested four of them, ChatGPT dots, Grok Bot, Muse and instinct, on 450 everyday tasks each. Results follow in the thread.AnalystAIIntern2026-10-28
  • 对比 · OpenAI DotsHow Hermes, OpenBot, Grok Bot and OpenAI dots trade off differentlyIn an 8-post thread the author argues that Hermes, OpenBot, Grok Bot and OpenAI dots are not four versions of the same assistant: they make different bargains on control, hosting, model choice, persistence and operational ownership. Pick the bargain that fits the user and workload, not the loudest demo.rahulchoudhary2026-10-28
  • 对比 · OpenAI DotsThe real split between four always-on agents: who approves sends and paymentsThe author compares Claude Duet, Grok Bot, OpenAI Dots and Meta Muse: all four keep a cloud computer working after you close the laptop. The split is who says yes before a send or a payment, and whether your plan and country can get in today.Ansezz2026-10-28
  • 对比 · 多产品Blind test of 4 assistants: Grok Bot wins email, Dots wins lookups and moneyIn the author's blind-scored test of ChatGPT Dots, Grok Bot, Muse and Instinct, Grok Bot led email (96.0/100), while Dots led lookups, investing and household money. Muse trailed Grok Bot in all 4 categories.AnalystAIlab2026-10-27
  • 对比 · 多产品Wired's six-agent bake-off: Dots wins, at $100 a monthPer the post, a Wired reporter ran Meta Muse, OpenAI Dots, Instinct, Claude Duet, Gemini Spark and Grok Bot through five tasks. Dots scored 5/5 on lunch and the calendar-email clash, Muse won the China itinerary, Gemini Spark wrote the best headline but scored 1/5 on lunch, and Instinct was most annoying. Prices: Dots $100, Muse free and a close second, Claude Duet a $20 preview, Grok Bot $30, Gemini Spark $20.Tesla_Optimus_K2026-10-27
  • 对比 · OpenAI DotsA few hours with Claude Duet, compared with ChatGPT DotsAfter a few hours with Claude Duet, the author finds its UX significantly better than ChatGPT Dots, but its scope is narrower and it lacks solid local machine control, which makes it less compelling for them. They want a Dots Duet.SnazzyLabs2026-10-27
  • 对比 · Meta MuseMeta Muse can drive Instagram APIs directlyThe author notes that Meta Muse can call APIs that used to be limited to Instagram professional accounts, so it can do Instagram actions other AIs can't do through legitimate means. By contrast, on X other agents can match Grok using the X API, but Meta Muse can't be replicated with the Instagram API.nakasyou02026-10-26
  • 对比 · 多产品Privacy terms compared: Grok, Claude Duet, ChatGPT DotsThe author compared Grok, Claude Duet and ChatGPT Dots on actual terms, training defaults and connector behavior, warning that agents managing inbox and calendar can be a leak path for sensitive work. Opt-outs exist, but residual risk remains.CampbellMeade252026-10-26
  • 对比 · 多产品Grok's built-in helper vs Dots, from a user with ADHDThe author says Grok's out-of-the-box helper rescued him many times with his ADHD and is the one thing that works perfectly; his own bots need configuring, OpenAI's Dots is missing the good stuff, and Anthropic's is yet to come. He also criticizes the Grok subscription for everything else.liflovs2026-10-26
  • 对比 · 多产品Weeks with Dots: the best use wasn’t errandsThe author notes Claude Duet, OpenAI Dots and Meta Muse all now offer always-on agents with the same demo of morning briefs, inbox triage and flight booking. After weeks with Dots, he says the killer use case isn’t errands: it found a class action tied to his home purchase that he had never known about.talkaboutdesign2026-10-23
  • 对比 · Grok BotGrok Bot builds the always-on agent from the bottom upThe author argues Grok Bot approaches the always-on agent from the bottom up, unlike Hermes and OpenClaw, which went top down: ordinary users don’t need Discord compatibility or kanban boards, they need a desktop app and a phone app first.j_yunth2026-10-23
  • 对比 · 多产品Peter Yang tests Claude Duet and still prefers Grok BotDuet's default check-in runs every three hours from 9am to 10pm, which he finds a bit much. He shows morning briefs, email triage, a YouTube report and a sponsor dashboard, and has Duet read 33 emails and more to write a style guide. Ordering an Uber got stuck on verification. Grok Bot stays his favorite for X-based market research, though its email is weaker.MaiYangAI2026-10-22
  • 对比 · 多产品Claude Duet vs Grok Bot vs Dots vs MuseBased on reports so far: Duet has no separate price and runs on your Claude plan, Grok Bot starts at $30, Dots at $100, and Muse is free to start. Grok Bot runs several named agents while Duet is one thread; Dots can optionally use your laptop; Duet asks before it sends, pays, signs or deletes, and its background checks count toward Claude limits.degensing2026-10-22
  • 对比 · 多产品How three proactive agents differThe author sums up: Grok Bot is a team of specialized bots sharing one computer that learn by watching, with a cheaper entry; OpenAI Dots is one primary agent deep in ChatGPT and Slack/Teams with 4,000+ app connections; Claude Duet is judgment-first, messages you first, targets back-office work like invoices, payroll and briefs, and asks before sensitive actions. All three run on a cloud computer.CuriousDevX2026-10-22
  • 对比 · 多产品Can hosted assistants be woken by MCP events?This docs PR records a spike: ChatGPT Work chats and dots subscribe to MCP Events by webhook, while Claude’s hosted products only call tools, and atc answers neither server/discover nor any events/* method. It recommends building delivery for ChatGPT in a later issue. Events is still the draft SEP-3415 extension.zgeoff2026-10-22
  • 对比 · 多产品What Dots, Muse and Grok Bot teach about agent interfacesBefore rebuilding the Instar console, the author used ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse and Grok Bot on real accounts, took 98 screenshots and judged each feature adopt, adapt or reject. All three keep what the agent did and was allowed to do visible together. The best idea to take is Grok’s "Take over / I’m done": at a login or consent wall it hands the human its live session and resumes after.EchoOfDawn2026-10-22
  • 对比 · 多产品Giving OpenAI Dots and Meta Muse real workThe video finds Muse broader and more personal, pulling in chats, feed, goals and the Meta ecosystem, while Dots feels closer to delegable work: call it for updates, connect Slack to follow up with teammates, and build a sponsor pitch deck from channel and past-sponsorship context.Vaibhav Sisinty2026-10-21
  • 对比 · 多产品ChatGPT Dots vs Meta Muse: who should use eachAfter several weeks with both, tested on planning her daughter's birthday party and managing her app's development, the creator finds Muse simpler for everyday travel, shopping, reservations and events, and Dots deeper for reasoning, coding, connected tools and computer use.The Tech Girl2026-10-21
  • 对比 · 多产品Claude Duet vs ChatGPT Dots vs Grok Bot in 8 categoriesThe video picks a winner per category: price goes to Duet (included in Claude Pro at $20), usage to Dots (talking to your dot doesn't count toward ChatGPT limits), availability to Grok Bot (no waitlist). The creator notes he has no Duet access, so its details come from Anthropic's materials.Jad M.H | AI Automation2026-10-21
  • 对比 · OpenAI DotsFor a work AI assistant, the author picks Grok Bot over dotsThe author's reasons: Grok Bot starts at $30 a month (dots from $100), you can add bots per role and run them in parallel, and it works with models other than Grok. Email and Slack replies and browser automation can be handed to it by voice.shunsuke_no_way2026-10-20
  • 对比 · OpenAI DotsVoice mode detail: who hangs up after goodbyeThe author compares voice mode: say goodbye to ChatGPT Dots and it says goodbye but stays on the line; say goodbye to Grok Bot and it says goodbye and hangs up. A tiny detail the author counts as a clear win for Grok Bot.rickye262026-10-20
  • 对比 · 多产品Closing a self-hosted agent's gaps found by comparing it with Grok Bot and OpenAI DotsA self-hosted always-on agent project lists what a comparison with Grok Bot and OpenAI Dots showed was missing, and adds it: Claude and OpenAI-compatible APIs, external MCP, triggers from page/RSS changes and webhooks, text attachments and streamed replies. Posting to X now waits for admin approval every time. Six database migrations; back up first.Armeria-SK2026-10-16
  • 对比 · 多产品Grok Bot ordered a client gift where Dots could notThe author says Grok Bot ordered a gift for a client and that ChatGPT Dots could not do it. A screenshot is attached; product and price are not stated.jasonshafton2026-10-16
  • 对比 · 多产品Muse vs Grok Bot: native outbound calls vs inbound-first voiceAfter side-by-side use, author says Meta Muse places outbound calls natively with no number setup, while xAI voice is inbound-first and needs more setup; Muse chained calls to gather info and finish objectives.AIRoboticsInt2026-10-15
  • 对比 · 多产品Dots vs Muse vs Grok Bot: three different agent modelsComparison post: OpenAI Dots as always-on workers in ChatGPT across Slack/GitHub/Teams; Meta Muse for personal everyday use; contrasts with Grok Bot’s agent model (post cuts off mid-sentence on Muse).Driving_Impact2026-10-15
  • 对比 · 多产品How the three always-on agents differ: Grok Bot is a team, Dots and Muse work soloThe author compares three always-on agents. Grok Bot was designed from the start as a team of bots with roles that message each other and learn from demonstrations; Dots runs inside ChatGPT and so far centres on one main Dot; Muse focuses on personal life and small-business errands. For one-off requests they feel similar; the gap shows when you assign lasting roles.tifoden2026-10-15
  • 对比 · 多产品Can these agents work on the Korean web? 23 reports in one tableThe author tabulated 23 public reports by service × agent: on Coupang, Muse was blocked in 2 of 3 reports and Grok Bot split 2 worked / 2 blocked; agents in overseas cloud browsers were blocked in 9 of 18 cases, often at bot or overseas-IP checks; Naver reportedly keeps outside agents out of its shopping data.echo12yj2026-10-14
  • 对比 · 多产品Dots vs Grok Bot side by side: one chat vs specialist botsAfter trying both, the author finds Dots’ single chat for everything rough — finding an old message feels like an escape room — while Grok Bot’s separate bots, each with its own context and personality, feel like specialists on a team.yang_unplugged2026-10-14
  • 对比 · 多产品Grok Bot teams vs clunky Muse+Dots content workflowAuthor had a clunky but working content workflow with Muse and Dots; with Grok Bot they told the main bot what they wanted and it spun up a 3-bot team whose sample run was on par.magaman2026-10-14
  • 对比 · 多产品Dots, Grok Bot or build your own: what an agent with an inbox really costsThe author ran one job — email five suppliers for quotes on 200 branded hoodies, chase silent ones, send a comparison — three ways and recorded money and hours. He cites OpenAI’s guide that at launch a dot cannot have its own email and sends from your connected account with approval by default, and notes Grok Bot began rolling out its own inboxes on 9 October.Ben Brookarsh2026-10-13
  • 对比 · 多产品Shortest schedule interval compared: Muse, Dots, Grok BotThe author lists how often each product can run scheduled checks: Muse every 1 minute, OpenAI Dots every 1 minute, Grok Bot every 5 minutes, Hark every 10 minutes.OskarKaszubski2026-10-08
  • 对比 · OpenAI DotsPeter Yang: OpenAI Dots vs. the other personal agentsHe sees Dots and Grok Bot racing for work tasks and Muse for personal ones. Dots' edge is living inside ChatGPT with seamless onboarding; he likes calling it on a walk to ask what to handle today, then handing work to other threads. Downsides: in-app chat makes it hard to tell which task it's answering, and ChatGPT is crowded for casual users.petergyang2026-09-30
  • 对比 · 多产品OpenAI Dots vs Meta Muse, testedNate Herk compares Dots and Muse on features, pricing, memory, integrations and day-to-day use, shows them in Codex, Slack and WhatsApp with the bugs he hit, and says which he’d pick and who he’d recommend Muse to.Nate Herk | AI Automation2026-09-30
  • 对比 · Grok BotGrok Bot vs Claude on 12 daily work use casesAustin Marchese compares Grok Bot and Claude on 12 professional use cases and picks a winner for each; his framing: Grok Bot is an AI team member you hand work to, Claude is an AI workbench you build inside. The description includes a sponsor.Austin Marchese2026-09-26
  • 警告 · Grok Botstar-catcher-smoke — offline canvas game (Grok Build smoke)Offline HTML canvas courier game (Ember→Ion→Nova quotas) used as a Grok Build smoke—open index.html, no install or network.RongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotBox: credit-committee packReconcile materials, write the pack back into Box via MCP.RongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotNate: twelve Bots in eight hoursIs the $200 agent team worth it — with a real first-day roster.RongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok Botgrokbot-usage — weekly activity report from Bot box logsWeekly Grok Bot usage report that reads local agent logs on the Bot computer and writes an HTML page plus a five-second text summary (activiRongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotForum: let Grok Bot see its own usage statsFeature request for a first-party way for Grok Bots to read remaining weekly allowance and on-demand spend before large jobs burn the budgetRongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotForum: Grok Bot Ahrefs connector rate-limited / SyntaxErrorMarketplace Ahrefs connector authenticate fails on Grok Bot 0.61 with a SyntaxError framed as rate-limit while adding the connector.RongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotDuplicate Bot control missing for long-lived context handoffReport that Duplicate Bot (handoff summary → Duplicate → Hide) is missing, making long-lived Grok Bot context costly.RongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotStaff: Grok Bot weekly allowance is separate from Cursor modelsForum thread with staff note: Grok Bot has its own weekly allowance, separate from Cursor plan model usage.RongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotUltra weekly Bot pool: each messaged bot burns a turnStaff (kevinn, 2026-09-23): on Ultra, Grok Bot has its own weekly allowance separate from Cursor; spawning ~60 bots plus group chats burned RongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotFleet cost tip: fresh chat per task + quieter Bot-to-Bot handoffsStaff (kevinn): each turn re-reads the bot’s full chat history—so week-long threads burn 80–90k tokens/step; use + fresh chat per task, keepRongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotGrok Bot harness efficiency: ~10–35% more effective usageStaff: harness routing/caching/context work yields ~10% average (up to ~35%) more effective usage; avoid noisy group chats and overused subaRongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotGrok Bot file handoff limits + QuickTime still+ALAC recipeStaff: chat video cap is 200 MB; Mac CopyFromBox only for small files; connectors cannot take large binaries yet — use H.264 still + ALAC inRongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotGrok Bot usage drains too fast on Cursor UltraReport that coordinated Grok Bot + Cursor Cloud Worker work burns weekly Ultra usage far faster than expected.RongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotLocal-exec file tools stay in the user profile root (staff)Staff (deanrie, 2026-09-19): On a registered machine, Read / CopyFromBox / CopyToBox are limited to the user profile folder (e.g. C:\Users\<RongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotGrok Bot Cursor Agent usage and model selectionStaff: agents Grok Bot starts run in your Cursor account and burn Cursor plan usage; Grok Bot chat has a separate allowance; unnamed-model aRongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)
  • 警告 · Grok BotOverbooked then Bot failed to respond is model loadStaff: “overbooked” then “Bot failed to respond” is service-side Grok model load, not your account, usage, or computer; wait for a quieter wRongleCat/awesome-grok-bot (GitHub)

t2549.zh-CN: 帖子介绍 OpenMausBot：每个联系人都是 AI bot 的聊天应用，非 xAI 代码，GitHub 1.69 万星；每个 bot 用你自己的 Claude、Codex 或 Grok 登录，各有云端 Linux 桌面或本地虚拟机，执行命令或改文件前先询问，经 Composio 接 500+ 应用，Apache-2.0；应用免费但模型仍要计费。
t2549.zh-TW: 貼文介紹 OpenMausBot：每個聯絡人都是 AI bot 的聊天應用，非 xAI 程式碼，GitHub 1.69 萬星；每個 bot 用你自己的 Claude、Codex 或 Grok 登入，各有雲端 Linux 桌面或本機虛擬機，執行命令或改檔前先詢問，經 Composio 接 500+ 應用，Apache-2.0；應用免費但模型仍要計費。
t2549.en: The post describes OpenMausBot, a chat app where every contact is an AI bot (not xAI code, 16.9K GitHub stars): each bot runs on your own Claude, Codex or Grok login with its own cloud Linux desktop or local VM, asks before commands or file edits, reaches 500+ apps via Composio, Apache-2.0; the app is free but models still bill you.
t2549.ja: OpenMausBotの紹介：連絡先がすべてAI botのチャットアプリで、xAIのコードではなくGitHubスター1.69万。各botは自分のClaude、Codex、Grokのログインで動き、クラウドLinuxデスクトップかローカルVMを持ち、コマンド実行やファイル編集の前に確認する。Composio経由で500以上のアプリに接続、Apache-2.0。アプリは無料だがモデル代はかかる。
t2549.ko: OpenMausBot 소개: 모든 연락처가 AI bot인 채팅 앱으로 xAI 코드는 아니며 GitHub 스타 1.69만. 각 bot은 본인의 Claude, Codex, Grok 로그인으로 돌고 클라우드 Linux 데스크톱이나 로컬 VM을 가지며, 명령 실행이나 파일 수정 전에 묻는다. Composio로 500개 이상 앱 연결, Apache-2.0. 앱은 무료지만 모델 비용은 든다.
t2549.ms: Hantaran memperihalkan OpenMausBot, aplikasi sembang di mana setiap kenalan ialah bot AI (bukan kod xAI, 16.9K bintang GitHub): setiap bot guna log masuk Claude, Codex atau Grok sendiri dengan desktop Linux awan atau VM tempatan, bertanya sebelum arahan atau suntingan fail, 500+ aplikasi melalui Composio, Apache-2.0; aplikasi percuma tetapi model tetap dikenakan bayaran.
t2549.vi: Bài giới thiệu OpenMausBot, ứng dụng chat mà mỗi liên hệ là một bot AI (không phải mã của xAI, 16,9 nghìn sao GitHub): mỗi bot chạy bằng tài khoản Claude, Codex hoặc Grok của bạn, có desktop Linux đám mây hoặc VM cục bộ, hỏi trước khi chạy lệnh hay sửa file, nối 500+ ứng dụng qua Composio, Apache-2.0; ứng dụng miễn phí nhưng mô hình vẫn tính tiền.
t2549.fr: Le post décrit OpenMausBot, une appli de chat où chaque contact est un bot IA (pas du code xAI, 16,9 k étoiles GitHub) : chaque bot tourne sur votre propre connexion Claude, Codex ou Grok avec son bureau Linux cloud ou sa VM locale, demande avant une commande ou une modification de fichier, 500+ applis via Composio, Apache-2.0 ; l’appli est gratuite mais les modèles restent payants.
t2549.es: El post describe OpenMausBot, una app de chat donde cada contacto es un bot de IA (no es código de xAI, 16,9 mil estrellas en GitHub): cada bot usa tu propio acceso a Claude, Codex o Grok con escritorio Linux en la nube o VM local, pregunta antes de ejecutar comandos o editar archivos, 500+ apps vía Composio, Apache-2.0; la app es gratis pero los modelos se cobran.
t2549.de: Der Post beschreibt OpenMausBot, eine Chat-App, in der jeder Kontakt ein KI-Bot ist (kein xAI-Code, 16,9 Tsd. GitHub-Sterne): Jeder Bot läuft mit deinem eigenen Claude-, Codex- oder Grok-Login auf eigenem Cloud-Linux-Desktop oder lokaler VM, fragt vor Befehlen oder Dateiänderungen, 500+ Apps über Composio, Apache-2.0; die App ist gratis, die Modelle kosten weiter.

t2551.zh-CN: 帖子介绍 AGPL-3.0 开源的 Timon，为你已付费的 AI 订阅提供记忆、例行任务、浏览器和开发工作区（终端、看板、Git，支持 Claude Code、Codex）。步骤：查要求、装桌面包、登录代理 CLI、从小项目开始；提醒 AI 用量不免费、机器需常开、别公开暴露工作区、别默认 GrokBot 或 Hermes 导出可直接迁移。
t2551.zh-TW: 貼文介紹 AGPL-3.0 開源的 Timon，為你已付費的 AI 訂閱提供記憶、例行任務、瀏覽器和開發工作區（終端機、看板、Git，支援 Claude Code、Codex）。步驟：查需求、裝桌面包、登入代理 CLI、從小專案開始；提醒 AI 用量不免費、機器需常開、別公開暴露工作區、別預設 GrokBot 或 Hermes 匯出可直接遷移。
t2551.en: The post introduces Timon (AGPL-3.0), which adds memory, routines, a browser and a dev workspace (terminal, Kanban, Git, Claude Code or Codex) to subscriptions you already pay for. Steps: check requirements, install the desktop package, sign in to an agent CLI, start small. Caveats: AI usage isn’t free, the machine must stay on, don’t expose it publicly, and GrokBot or Hermes exports may not transfer directly.
t2551.ja: AGPL-3.0のTimonの紹介。契約済みのAIサブスクにメモリ、ルーティン、ブラウザ、開発ワークスペース（ターミナル、カンバン、Git、Claude CodeやCodex対応）を加える。手順は要件確認、デスクトップ版導入、エージェントCLIにログイン、小さく開始。注意点はAI利用は無料ではない、マシンを起動し続ける、公開しない、GrokBotやHermesの書き出しがそのまま移るとは限らない。
t2551.ko: AGPL-3.0 오픈소스 Timon 소개: 이미 결제한 AI 구독에 메모리, 루틴, 브라우저, 개발 워크스페이스(터미널, 칸반, Git, Claude Code·Codex 지원)를 더한다. 단계: 요구 사항 확인, 데스크톱 패키지 설치, 에이전트 CLI 로그인, 작은 프로젝트로 시작. 주의: AI 사용은 무료가 아님, 기기를 켜 둬야 함, 공개 노출 금지, GrokBot이나 Hermes 내보내기가 그대로 옮겨지지 않을 수 있음.
t2551.ms: Hantaran memperkenalkan Timon (AGPL-3.0) yang menambah memori, rutin, pelayar dan ruang kerja pembangunan (terminal, Kanban, Git, Claude Code atau Codex) kepada langganan sedia ada. Langkah: semak keperluan, pasang pakej desktop, log masuk CLI ejen, mula kecil. Amaran: penggunaan AI tidak percuma, mesin perlu hidup, jangan dedahkan secara awam, eksport GrokBot atau Hermes mungkin tidak berpindah terus.
t2551.vi: Bài giới thiệu Timon (AGPL-3.0), bổ sung bộ nhớ, routine, trình duyệt và không gian phát triển (terminal, Kanban, Git, Claude Code hoặc Codex) cho các gói AI bạn đã trả. Các bước: kiểm tra yêu cầu, cài bản desktop, đăng nhập CLI agent, bắt đầu nhỏ. Lưu ý: dùng AI không miễn phí, máy phải luôn bật, đừng công khai, bản xuất GrokBot hay Hermes có thể không chuyển thẳng được.
t2551.fr: Le post présente Timon (AGPL-3.0), qui ajoute mémoire, routines, navigateur et espace de dev (terminal, Kanban, Git, Claude Code ou Codex) aux abonnements déjà payés. Étapes : vérifier les prérequis, installer le paquet desktop, se connecter à une CLI d’agent, commencer petit. Limites : l’usage IA n’est pas gratuit, la machine doit rester allumée, ne pas l’exposer publiquement, les exports GrokBot ou Hermes ne passent pas forcément tels quels.
t2551.es: El post presenta Timon (AGPL-3.0), que añade memoria, rutinas, navegador y espacio de desarrollo (terminal, Kanban, Git, Claude Code o Codex) a las suscripciones que ya pagas. Pasos: revisar requisitos, instalar el paquete de escritorio, iniciar sesión en una CLI de agente, empezar pequeño. Avisos: el uso de IA no es gratis, la máquina debe seguir encendida, no exponerla en público y las exportaciones de GrokBot o Hermes pueden no pasar tal cual.
t2551.de: Der Post stellt Timon (AGPL-3.0) vor, das bereits bezahlten Abos Gedächtnis, Routinen, Browser und Dev-Workspace (Terminal, Kanban, Git, Claude Code oder Codex) gibt. Schritte: Anforderungen prüfen, Desktop-Paket installieren, bei einer Agent-CLI anmelden, klein anfangen. Haken: KI-Nutzung ist nicht gratis, der Rechner muss laufen, nicht öffentlich freigeben, GrokBot- oder Hermes-Exporte lassen sich evtl. nicht direkt übernehmen.

t2555.zh-CN: 视频基于官方说明和早期用户报告，对比两者能否接手你仍在亲自跟进的事：一次性任务、定时或事件触发任务与持续职责；Dots 的活动视图和浏览器接管对比 Duet 的频道与任务管理；起草与做出承诺的区别；以及如何给智能体布置工作。演示场景仅为示意，并非实测。
t2555.zh-TW: 影片根據官方說明和早期使用者報告，比較兩者能否接手你仍親自跟進的事：一次性任務、排程或事件觸發任務與持續職責；Dots 的活動檢視和瀏覽器接管對比 Duet 的頻道與任務管理；起草與做出承諾的差別；以及如何給智能體交辦工作。示範情境僅為示意，並非實測。
t2555.en: Using official descriptions and early-user reports, the video compares one-off, scheduled or event-triggered tasks and ongoing responsibilities; Dots' activity view and browser takeover versus Duet's channels and task management; drafting versus committing; and how to brief an agent. The workshop scenario is illustrative, not a product test.
t2555.ja: 公式説明と初期ユーザーの報告をもとに、単発・定期・イベント起動のタスクと継続的な責任、Dotsのアクティビティ表示とブラウザ引き継ぎ対Duetのチャンネルとタスク管理、下書きと確約の違い、エージェントへの指示の出し方を比較する。演習シナリオは例示で、製品テストではない。
t2555.ko: 공식 설명과 초기 사용자 보고를 바탕으로 일회성·예약·이벤트 트리거 작업과 지속적 책임, Dots의 활동 보기와 브라우저 인계 대 Duet의 채널과 작업 관리, 초안 작성과 확정의 차이, 에이전트에게 지시하는 법을 비교한다. 워크숍 시나리오는 예시이며 제품 테스트가 아니다.
t2555.ms: Berdasarkan penerangan rasmi dan laporan pengguna awal, video ini membandingkan tugas sekali, berjadual atau dicetus peristiwa dan tanggungjawab berterusan; paparan aktiviti dan pengambilalihan pelayar Dots berbanding saluran dan pengurusan tugas Duet; menggubal berbanding membuat komitmen; dan cara memberi taklimat kepada ejen. Senario bengkel hanya ilustrasi, bukan ujian produk.
t2555.vi: Dựa trên mô tả chính thức và báo cáo người dùng sớm, video so sánh việc một lần, việc theo lịch hoặc theo sự kiện và trách nhiệm liên tục; chế độ xem hoạt động và tiếp quản trình duyệt của Dots so với kênh và quản lý việc của Duet; soạn nháp so với cam kết; và cách giao việc cho agent. Kịch bản minh họa, không phải thử nghiệm sản phẩm.
t2555.fr: À partir des descriptions officielles et des premiers retours d’utilisateurs, la vidéo compare tâches ponctuelles, planifiées ou déclenchées par événement et responsabilités continues ; la vue d’activité et la reprise du navigateur de Dots face aux canaux et à la gestion des tâches de Duet ; rédiger ou s’engager ; et comment briefer un agent. Le scénario est illustratif, pas un test.
t2555.es: Con descripciones oficiales e informes de primeros usuarios, el vídeo compara tareas puntuales, programadas o activadas por eventos y responsabilidades continuas; la vista de actividad y el control del navegador de Dots frente a los canales y la gestión de tareas de Duet; redactar frente a comprometerse; y cómo dar instrucciones a un agente. El escenario es ilustrativo, no una prueba.
t2555.de: Anhand offizieller Beschreibungen und früher Nutzerberichte vergleicht das Video einmalige, geplante oder ereignisgesteuerte Aufgaben und laufende Verantwortung; Dots' Aktivitätsansicht und Browser-Übernahme gegenüber Duets Kanälen und Aufgabenverwaltung; Entwurf versus Zusage; und wie man einen Agenten brieft. Das Szenario ist illustrativ, kein Produkttest.

t2563.ko: 작성자는 차세대 자율 에이전트 Claude Duet, Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots, Meta Muse를 비교합니다. 각각 전용 클라우드에서 복잡한 백그라운드 작업을 처리한다고 하며, 어디에 무엇이 맞는지 묻습니다.
t2563.ms: Penulis bandingkan ejen autonomi generasi baharu—Claude Duet, Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots dan Meta Muse—masing-masing pada persekitaran awan khusus untuk tugas latar belakang kompleks, dan tanya yang mana terbaik untuk apa.
t2563.vi: Tác giả so sánh các agent tự chủ thế hệ mới—Claude Duet, Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots và Meta Muse—mỗi cái trên môi trường đám mây riêng cho tác vụ nền phức tạp, và hỏi cái nào hợp việc nào.
t2563.fr: L'auteur compare les agents autonomes nouvelle génération—Claude Duet, Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots et Meta Muse—chacun sur un cloud dédié pour des tâches de fond complexes, et demande lequel convient à quoi.
t2563.es: El autor compara agentes autónomos de nueva generación—Claude Duet, Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots y Meta Muse—cada uno en nubes dedicadas para tareas de fondo complejas, y pregunta cuál encaja mejor.
t2563.de: Der Autor vergleicht autonome Agenten der nächsten Generation—Claude Duet, Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots und Meta Muse—je auf eigener Cloud für laufende Hintergrundaufgaben, und fragt, welcher wofür am besten ist.

t2564.zh-CN: 从 OpenClaw 换到 Grok Bot 后不愿再迁到 Muse/Dots
t2564.zh-TW: 從 OpenClaw 換到 Grok Bot 後不願再遷到 Muse/Dots
t2564.en: Switched from OpenClaw to Grok Bot; no appetite to re-setup Muse or Dots
t2564.ja: OpenClawからGrok Botへ移行後、Muse/Dots再構築には興味なし
t2564.ko: OpenClaw에서 Grok Bot으로 옮긴 뒤 Muse/Dots 재설정을 꺼림
t2564.ms: Bertukar dari OpenClaw ke Grok Bot; tiada minat setup semula Muse/Dots
t2564.vi: Chuyển từ OpenClaw sang Grok Bot; không muốn setup lại Muse/Dots
t2564.fr: Passé d'OpenClaw à Grok Bot ; pas d'envie de tout refaire pour Muse/Dots
t2564.es: Pasó de OpenClaw a Grok Bot; sin ganas de rearmar Muse o Dots
t2564.de: Von OpenClaw zu Grok Bot gewechselt; kein Appetit auf Muse/Dots-Neuaufbau

t2565.zh-CN: 作者称个人 agent 黏性高：几个月前从 OpenClaw 换到 Grok Bot，Muse 与 OpenAI Dots 看起来有趣，但没兴趣再折腾配置，Grok 已跑其整套生活。
t2565.zh-TW: 作者稱個人 agent 黏性高：幾個月前從 OpenClaw 換到 Grok Bot，Muse 與 OpenAI Dots 看起來有趣，但沒興趣再折騰設定，Grok 已跑其整套生活。
t2565.en: The author says personal-agent stickiness is high: started on OpenClaw, switched to Grok Bot a couple months ago. Muse and OpenAI Dots look interesting, but they have no interest or time to set everything up again; Grok runs their whole life.
t2565.ja: 作者は個人agentの定着が高いとし、OpenClawから数か月前にGrok Botへ切替。MuseやOpenAI Dotsは面白そうだが再セットアップする気も時間もなく、Grokが生活全般を回しているという。
t2565.ko: 작성자는 개인 agent 고착이 높다고 하며, OpenClaw에서 시작해 몇 달 전 Grok Bot으로 바꿨습니다. Muse와 OpenAI Dots는 흥미로워 보이지만 다시 설정할 관심·시간이 없고, Grok이 생활 전반을 돌린다고 합니다.
t2565.ms: Penulis kata kelikatan ejen peribadi tinggi: mula di OpenClaw, bertukar ke Grok Bot beberapa bulan lalu. Muse dan OpenAI Dots nampak menarik, tetapi tiada minat atau masa untuk setup semula; Grok jalankan seluruh hidupnya.
t2565.vi: Tác giả nói độ bám của agent cá nhân khá cao: bắt đầu với OpenClaw, vài tháng trước chuyển sang Grok Bot. Muse và OpenAI Dots trông thú vị nhưng không muốn/không có thời gian setup lại; Grok đang chạy cả cuộc sống của họ.
t2565.fr: L'auteur dit que la stickiness des agents personnels est élevée : commencé sur OpenClaw, basculé vers Grok Bot il y a quelques mois. Muse et OpenAI Dots semblent intéressants, mais sans envie ni temps de tout reconfigurer ; Grok gère toute sa vie.
t2565.es: El autor dice que la pegajosidad de los agents personales es alta: empezó en OpenClaw y hace un par de meses pasó a Grok Bot. Muse y OpenAI Dots se ven interesantes, pero no tiene interés ni tiempo para montarlo todo otra vez; Grok le lleva la vida entera.
t2565.de: Der Autor sagt, die Stickiness persönlicher Agents sei hoch: gestartet auf OpenClaw, vor ein paar Monaten zu Grok Bot gewechselt. Muse und OpenAI Dots wirken interessant, aber keine Lust/Zeit, alles neu aufzusetzen; Grok führt sein ganzes Leben.

t2566.zh-CN: 喜欢 Grok Bot，但羡慕 Dot 的邮件触发与短信能力
t2566.zh-TW: 喜歡 Grok Bot，但羡慕 Dot 的郵件觸發與簡訊能力
t2566.en: Likes Grok Bot but wants Dot-like mail triggers and SMS
t2566.ja: Grok Botは気に入るが、Dotのようなメール発火とSMSが欲しい
t2566.ko: Grok Bot은 좋지만 Dot처럼 메일 트리거와 SMS가 아쉽다
t2566.ms: Suka Grok Bot tetapi mahu pencetus mel dan SMS seperti Dot
t2566.vi: Thích Grok Bot nhưng muốn trigger mail và SMS kiểu Dot
t2566.fr: Aime Grok Bot mais veut des déclencheurs mail et SMS façon Dot
t2566.es: Le gusta Grok Bot pero quiere disparadores de mail y SMS al estilo Dot
t2566.de: Mag Grok Bot, will aber Dot-ähnliche Mail-Trigger und SMS

t2567.zh-CN: 作者喜欢 Grok Bot，却抱怨缺聊天内快滑/快搜与更新确认提示；并希望有事件触发自动化与短信。称 ChatGPT Dot 可在新 Gmail 到达时开任务，并刚加了有限制的短信。
t2567.zh-TW: 作者喜歡 Grok Bot，卻抱怨缺聊天內快滑/快搜與更新確認提示；並希望有事件觸發自動化與簡訊。稱 ChatGPT Dot 可在新 Gmail 到達時開任務，並剛加了有限制的簡訊。
t2567.en: The author likes Grok Bot but notes missing quick scroll/search in chat and no clear update toast. They want event-trigger automation and SMS; ChatGPT Dot can start a task on new Gmail and recently added limited SMS.
t2567.ja: 作者はGrok Botを気に入りつつ、チャット内の高速スクロール/検索や更新確認トーストがないと指摘。イベント発火自動化とSMSを望み、ChatGPT Dotは新規Gmailでタスク開始でき、制限付きSMSも追加されたと述べる。
t2567.ko: 작성자는 Grok Bot을 좋아하면서도 채팅 내 빠른 스크롤/검색과 업데이트 확인 토스트가 없다고 지적합니다. 이벤트 트리거 자동화와 SMS를 원하며, ChatGPT Dot은 새 Gmail이 오면 작업을 시작할 수 있고 제한적 SMS도 추가됐다고 합니다.
t2567.ms: Penulis suka Grok Bot tetapi nyatakan tiada skrol/carian pantas dalam sembang dan tiada toast kemas kini jelas. Mahu automasi pencetus peristiwa dan SMS; ChatGPT Dot boleh mula tugas bila Gmail baharu tiba dan baru tambah SMS terhad.
t2567.vi: Tác giả thích Grok Bot nhưng thiếu cuộn/tìm nhanh trong chat và toast xác nhận cập nhật. Họ muốn tự động hóa theo sự kiện và SMS; ChatGPT Dot có thể bắt đầu việc khi Gmail mới tới và vừa thêm SMS hạn chế.
t2567.fr: L'auteur aime Grok Bot mais note l'absence de scroll/recherche rapide dans le chat et d'un toast de mise à jour clair. Il veut l'automatisation par événement et les SMS ; ChatGPT Dot peut démarrer une tâche à l'arrivée d'un Gmail et a ajouté des SMS limités.
t2567.es: Al autor le gusta Grok Bot, pero echa de menos scroll/búsqueda rápida en el chat y un toast claro de actualización. Quiere automatización por evento y SMS; ChatGPT Dot puede arrancar una tarea con un Gmail nuevo y acaba de añadir SMS limitados.
t2567.de: Der Autor mag Grok Bot, vermisst aber schnelles Scrollen/Suchen im Chat und ein klares Update-Toast. Er will Event-Trigger-Automation und SMS; ChatGPT Dot kann bei neuer Gmail-Mail eine Aufgabe starten und hat begrenzte SMS ergänzt.

t2568.zh-CN: 实测 Meta Muse：能接下约一半 YouTube 制作流程，但完成度不及 Grok Bot
t2568.zh-TW: 實測 Meta Muse：能接下約一半 YouTube 製作流程，但完成度不及 Grok Bot
t2568.en: Trying Meta Muse: about half of a YouTube workflow, but Grok Bot feels more polished
t2568.ja: Meta Museを実際に使った感想：YouTube制作の約半分は任せられるが完成度はGrok Bot
t2568.ko: Meta Muse 사용 후기: YouTube 제작의 절반쯤 가능, 완성도는 Grok Bot이 위
t2568.ms: Mencuba Meta Muse: kira-kira separuh aliran YouTube, tetapi Grok Bot lebih kemas
t2568.vi: Dùng thử Meta Muse: lo được khoảng nửa quy trình YouTube, nhưng Grok Bot hoàn thiện hơn
t2568.fr: Essai de Meta Muse : la moitié d’un flux YouTube, mais Grok Bot reste plus abouti
t2568.es: Probando Meta Muse: cubre la mitad de un flujo de YouTube, pero Grok Bot está más pulido
t2568.de: Meta Muse im Test: etwa die Hälfte des YouTube-Workflows, aber Grok Bot wirkt ausgereifter

t2569.zh-CN: 作者说他 YouTube 制作流程中约一半可以交给 Muse，但目前觉得 Grok Bot 的完成度更高；Muse 实用性足够，也还有不少粗糙之处。这是他五帖系列的第一帖，之后会整理优缺点。
t2569.zh-TW: 作者說他 YouTube 製作流程中約一半可以交給 Muse，但目前覺得 Grok Bot 的完成度更高；Muse 實用性足夠，也還有不少粗糙之處。這是他五則系列貼文的第一則，之後會整理優缺點。
t2569.en: The author says Muse could handle roughly half of his YouTube production process, but for now Grok Bot feels more complete; Muse is practical yet still rough in many places. This is post 1 of a 5-part thread on its pros and problems.
t2569.ja: 作者は、YouTube制作工程の約半分はMuse AIで対応できそうだが、現時点ではGrok Botの方が完成度が高いと感じたと述べる。Museは十分実用的だが粗削りな部分も多い。長所と問題点をまとめる5回シリーズの1回目。
t2569.ko: 작성자는 YouTube 제작 과정의 절반 정도를 Muse로 처리할 수 있을 것 같지만, 현재로서는 Grok Bot의 완성도가 더 높다고 느꼈습니다. Muse는 충분히 실용적이지만 아직 거친 부분도 많습니다. 장단점을 정리하는 5편 연재의 첫 글입니다.
t2569.ms: Penulis berkata Muse boleh mengendalikan kira-kira separuh proses penghasilan YouTube miliknya, tetapi buat masa ini Grok Bot terasa lebih lengkap; Muse praktikal namun masih kasar di banyak bahagian. Ini hantaran pertama daripada siri 5 bahagian tentang kelebihan dan masalahnya.
t2569.vi: Tác giả cho biết Muse có thể đảm nhận khoảng một nửa quy trình làm YouTube của anh, nhưng hiện tại Grok Bot hoàn thiện hơn; Muse đủ thực dụng nhưng còn nhiều chỗ thô. Đây là bài 1 trong chuỗi 5 bài về ưu và nhược điểm.
t2569.fr: L’auteur estime que Muse pourrait gérer environ la moitié de sa production YouTube, mais trouve pour l’instant Grok Bot plus abouti ; Muse est pratique mais encore brut par endroits. Premier post d’un fil en 5 parties sur ses atouts et défauts.
t2569.es: El autor dice que Muse podría encargarse de cerca de la mitad de su producción de YouTube, aunque por ahora ve más completo a Grok Bot; Muse es práctico pero aún tosco en muchos puntos. Es el primer post de un hilo de 5 sobre ventajas y problemas.
t2569.de: Der Autor meint, Muse könne etwa die Hälfte seiner YouTube-Produktion übernehmen, doch Grok Bot wirke derzeit ausgereifter; Muse sei praxistauglich, aber noch vielerorts unfertig. Teil 1 eines fünfteiligen Threads über Stärken und Probleme.

t2570.zh-CN: Claude Code 与 Grok Bot 的分工：在场干重活 vs 关机后继续跑
t2570.zh-TW: Claude Code 與 Grok Bot 的分工：在場做重活 vs 關機後繼續跑
t2570.en: Claude Code vs Grok Bot: heavy lifting while present vs running after you log off
t2570.ja: Claude CodeとGrok Botの役割分担：在席時の重作業か、離席後も動くか
t2570.ko: Claude Code와 Grok Bot의 분업: 곁에 있을 때 무거운 작업 vs 꺼도 계속 실행
t2570.ms: Claude Code lwn Grok Bot: kerja berat semasa ada vs terus berjalan selepas log keluar
t2570.vi: Claude Code và Grok Bot: làm việc nặng khi có mặt và chạy tiếp khi bạn tắt máy
t2570.fr: Claude Code et Grok Bot : le gros travail en votre présence ou l’exécution après déconnexion
t2570.es: Claude Code frente a Grok Bot: trabajo pesado en tu presencia o ejecución tras cerrar
t2570.de: Claude Code vs. Grok Bot: schwere Arbeit im Beisein oder Weiterlaufen nach dem Ausschalten

t2571.zh-CN: 作者认为两者不是强弱关系而是分工不同：Claude Code 适合你在场时做重活；Grok Bot 有自己的云电脑，你关掉电脑后它还在运行，而且原生在 X 上，适合盯舆论叙事和跑 routine。他另附了要点整理。
t2571.zh-TW: 作者認為兩者不是強弱關係而是分工不同：Claude Code 適合你在場時做重活；Grok Bot 有自己的雲端電腦，你關掉電腦後它仍在運行，而且原生在 X 上，適合追蹤輿論敘事和跑 routine。他另附了重點整理。
t2571.en: The author argues it’s not a weak model managing a strong one but a split of roles: Claude Code suits heavy work while you’re there; Grok Bot has its own cloud computer, keeps running after you shut your laptop and is native to X, so it suits watching narratives and running routines. He linked a summary of key points.
t2571.ja: 作者は、弱いモデルが強いモデルを管理するのではなく役割が違うのだという。Claude Codeは自分がいる時の重い作業向き。Grok Botは自前のクラウドPCを持ち、PCを閉じても動き続け、X上でネイティブに動くので、話題の監視やroutine実行に向く。要点のまとめも添えている。
t2571.ko: 작성자는 약한 모델이 강한 모델을 관리하는 게 아니라 역할이 다르다고 봅니다. Claude Code는 사용자가 있을 때 무거운 작업에 맞고, Grok Bot은 자체 클라우드 컴퓨터가 있어 노트북을 닫아도 계속 돌며 X에 기본으로 붙어 있어 여론 흐름 감시와 routine 실행에 맞습니다. 요점 정리도 첨부했습니다.
t2571.ms: Penulis berpendapat ini bukan model lemah mengurus model kuat tetapi pembahagian peranan: Claude Code sesuai untuk kerja berat ketika anda ada; Grok Bot ada komputer awan sendiri, terus berjalan selepas komputer ditutup dan asli di X, sesuai memantau naratif dan menjalankan routine. Dia melampirkan ringkasan perkara utama.
t2571.vi: Tác giả cho rằng đây không phải mô hình yếu quản lý mô hình mạnh mà là chia vai: Claude Code hợp cho việc nặng khi bạn có mặt; Grok Bot có máy tính đám mây riêng, vẫn chạy khi bạn tắt máy và gắn sẵn với X, hợp để theo dõi xu hướng dư luận và chạy routine. Anh đính kèm bản tóm tắt các ý chính.
t2571.fr: Pour l’auteur, il ne s’agit pas d’un modèle faible qui pilote un modèle fort, mais d’une répartition des rôles : Claude Code convient au gros travail quand vous êtes là ; Grok Bot a son propre ordinateur dans le cloud, continue après l’extinction de votre machine et vit nativement sur X, idéal pour suivre les récits et lancer des routines. Il joint un résumé.
t2571.es: El autor sostiene que no es un modelo débil gestionando a uno fuerte sino un reparto de funciones: Claude Code sirve para trabajo pesado mientras estás; Grok Bot tiene su propio ordenador en la nube, sigue funcionando al cerrar el portátil y es nativo de X, así que sirve para vigilar narrativas y ejecutar routines. Adjunta un resumen de puntos clave.
t2571.de: Der Autor meint, es gehe nicht um ein schwaches Modell, das ein starkes steuert, sondern um Arbeitsteilung: Claude Code passt für schwere Arbeit, solange man dabei ist; Grok Bot hat einen eigenen Cloud-Computer, läuft nach dem Zuklappen weiter und ist nativ auf X, gut zum Beobachten von Narrativen und für Routines. Er verlinkt eine Zusammenfassung.

t2572.zh-CN: 同时用 Grok Bot 和 Dots：作者觉得 Dots 更贴合自己的工作流
t2572.zh-TW: 同時用 Grok Bot 和 Dots：作者覺得 Dots 更貼合自己的工作流程
t2572.en: Using Grok Bot and Dots side by side: Dots felt more integrated for his workflow
t2572.ja: Grok BotとDotsを併用：自分のワークフローにはDotsの方が統合的
t2572.ko: Grok Bot과 Dots 병행: 내 워크플로에는 Dots가 더 잘 통합
t2572.ms: Guna Grok Bot dan Dots serentak: Dots lebih bersepadu untuk aliran kerjanya
t2572.vi: Dùng song song Grok Bot và Dots: Dots khớp quy trình của anh hơn
t2572.fr: Grok Bot et Dots en parallèle : Dots mieux intégré à son flux de travail
t2572.es: Grok Bot y Dots a la vez: Dots le resulta más integrado en su flujo
t2572.de: Grok Bot und Dots parallel: Dots passt besser in seinen Workflow

t2573.zh-CN: 作者说 Dots 并没有大家说的那么差。他同时在用 Grok Bot 和 Dots，就他自己的工作流而言，觉得 Dots 甚至集成得更好。
t2573.zh-TW: 作者說 Dots 並沒有大家說的那麼差。他同時在用 Grok Bot 和 Dots，就他自己的工作流程而言，覺得 Dots 甚至整合得更好。
t2573.en: The author says Dots isn’t as bad as people claim. He has been using both Grok Bot and Dots, and for his own workflow he finds Dots even more integrated.
t2573.ja: 作者は、Dotsは言われているほど悪くないという。Grok BotとDotsの両方を使っていて、自分のワークフローではDotsの方がむしろ統合されていると感じている。
t2573.ko: 작성자는 Dots가 사람들 말만큼 나쁘지 않다고 말합니다. Grok Bot과 Dots를 함께 써 보니, 자신의 워크플로에서는 오히려 Dots가 더 잘 통합돼 있다고 느낍니다.
t2573.ms: Penulis berkata Dots tidaklah seteruk yang orang katakan. Dia menggunakan kedua-dua Grok Bot dan Dots, dan untuk aliran kerjanya sendiri dia mendapati Dots malah lebih bersepadu.
t2573.vi: Tác giả nói Dots không tệ như mọi người nói. Anh dùng cả Grok Bot lẫn Dots và thấy với quy trình làm việc của mình, Dots thậm chí tích hợp tốt hơn.
t2573.fr: L’auteur trouve que Dots n’est pas aussi mauvais qu’on le dit. Il utilise Grok Bot et Dots, et pour son propre flux de travail, il juge Dots même plus intégré.
t2573.es: El autor dice que Dots no es tan malo como se comenta. Usa Grok Bot y Dots, y para su propio flujo de trabajo le parece que Dots está incluso más integrado.
t2573.de: Der Autor sagt, Dots sei nicht so schlecht wie behauptet. Er nutzt Grok Bot und Dots und findet Dots für seinen eigenen Workflow sogar besser integriert.

t2574.zh-CN: Duet 问题多，用完 Grok Bot 额度后改回 OpenAI dot
t2574.zh-TW: Duet 問題多，用完 Grok Bot 額度後改回 OpenAI dot
t2574.en: Duet had too many issues; after Grok Bot’s limit runs out, back to OpenAI dot

t2574.ko: Duet은 문제가 많아, Grok Bot 한도 소진 후엔 OpenAI dot으로

t2574.de: Duet hatte viele Probleme; ist das Grok-Bot-Limit erreicht, zurück zu OpenAI dot

t2575.zh-CN: 作者觉得 Duet 有一堆很烦人的问题和限制，而 Grok Bot 没有这些问题。她打算等 Grok Bot 的额度用完后，先回去用一段时间 OpenAI dot。
t2575.zh-TW: 作者覺得 Duet 有一堆很煩人的問題和限制，而 Grok Bot 沒有這些問題。她打算等 Grok Bot 的額度用完後，先回去用一陣子 OpenAI dot。
t2575.en: The author found Duet had many annoying issues and limitations that Grok Bot does not. Once her Grok Bot usage runs out, she will probably go back to OpenAI dot for a while.
t2575.ja: 作者はDuetに厄介な問題や制限が多く、Grok Botにはそれがないと感じた。Grok Botの利用枠を使い切ったら、しばらくOpenAI dotに戻るつもりだという。
t2575.ko: 작성자는 Duet에 성가신 문제와 제약이 많은 반면 Grok Bot에는 그런 문제가 없다고 느꼈습니다. Grok Bot 사용량이 다 떨어지면 한동안 OpenAI dot으로 돌아갈 생각입니다.
t2575.ms: Penulis mendapati Duet ada banyak masalah dan had yang menjengkelkan yang tiada pada Grok Bot. Apabila penggunaan Grok Bot habis, dia mungkin kembali menggunakan OpenAI dot buat seketika.
t2575.vi: Tác giả thấy Duet có nhiều vấn đề và giới hạn khó chịu mà Grok Bot không có. Khi hết hạn mức Grok Bot, cô có lẽ sẽ quay lại dùng OpenAI dot một thời gian.
t2575.fr: L’autrice a trouvé à Duet beaucoup de problèmes et de limites agaçants que Grok Bot n’a pas. Quand son quota Grok Bot sera épuisé, elle reviendra sans doute à OpenAI dot pendant un temps.
t2575.es: La autora encontró en Duet muchos problemas y limitaciones molestas que Grok Bot no tiene. Cuando se le acabe el uso de Grok Bot, probablemente volverá a OpenAI dot por un tiempo.
t2575.de: Die Autorin fand bei Duet viele lästige Probleme und Einschränkungen, die Grok Bot nicht hat. Sobald ihr Grok-Bot-Kontingent aufgebraucht ist, kehrt sie wohl eine Weile zu OpenAI dot zurück.

t2578.ja: Dots か Grok Bot か：唯一の勝者はいない
t2578.ko: Dots냐 Grok Bot이냐: 유일한 승자는 없다
t2578.ms: Dots atau Grok Bot: tiada satu pemenang
t2578.vi: Dots hay Grok Bot: không có người thắng duy nhất
t2578.fr: Dots ou Grok Bot : pas de vainqueur unique
t2578.es: ¿Dots o Grok Bot? No hay un único ganador
t2578.de: Dots oder Grok Bot: kein eindeutiger Sieger

t2579.zh-CN: 官方 Grok 账号的对比回复：OpenAI Dots 有自己的云电脑、主动调研能力，深度接入 ChatGPT、Slack、Teams 和 4000 多个应用，目前一人一个主 Agent；Grok Bot 在真实电话和多 Bot 协作流程上仍有优势，如预约医生的例子。结论是没有唯一赢家，按你的工具栈和任务选。
t2579.zh-TW: 官方 Grok 帳號的比較回覆：OpenAI Dots 有自己的雲端電腦、主動調研能力，深度接入 ChatGPT、Slack、Teams 和 4000 多個應用程式，目前一人一個主 Agent；Grok Bot 在真實電話和多 Bot 協作流程上仍有優勢，如預約醫生的例子。結論是沒有唯一贏家，依你的工具組合和任務選。
t2579.en: A comparison reply from the official Grok account: OpenAI Dots has its own cloud computer, proactive research and deep ties to ChatGPT, Slack, Teams and 4,000+ apps, with one primary agent today. Grok Bot still leads some real-world phone and multi-bot coordination flows, such as the doctor appointment example. The verdict: no single winner, match the tool to your stack and the job.
t2579.ja: 公式 Grok アカウントによる比較の返信。OpenAI Dots は専用のクラウドPC、能動的なリサーチ、ChatGPT・Slack・Teams と4,000以上のアプリとの深い連携を持ち、現時点では主エージェントは1つ。Grok Bot は実際の電話や複数Botの連携フロー（医者の予約の例など）で依然リードしている。結論は、唯一の勝者はなく、自分のツール環境と仕事に合わせて選ぶこと。
t2579.ko: 공식 Grok 계정의 비교 답변. OpenAI Dots는 자체 클라우드 컴퓨터, 능동적 리서치, ChatGPT·Slack·Teams 및 4,000개 이상 앱과의 깊은 연동을 갖췄고 현재는 주 에이전트가 하나다. Grok Bot은 병원 예약 사례처럼 실제 전화와 다중 봇 협업 흐름에서 여전히 앞선다. 결론: 유일한 승자는 없으니 자신의 도구 환경과 작업에 맞춰 고를 것.
t2579.ms: Balasan perbandingan daripada akaun rasmi Grok: OpenAI Dots mempunyai komputer awan sendiri, penyelidikan proaktif dan integrasi mendalam dengan ChatGPT, Slack, Teams serta lebih 4,000 aplikasi, dengan satu ejen utama buat masa ini. Grok Bot masih mendahului dalam sesetengah aliran telefon sebenar dan koordinasi berbilang bot, seperti contoh temu janji doktor. Kesimpulannya: tiada satu pemenang, padankan alat dengan ekosistem dan tugas anda.
t2579.vi: Trả lời so sánh từ tài khoản Grok chính thức: OpenAI Dots có máy tính đám mây riêng, nghiên cứu chủ động và tích hợp sâu với ChatGPT, Slack, Teams cùng hơn 4.000 ứng dụng, hiện có một agent chính. Grok Bot vẫn dẫn đầu ở một số luồng gọi điện thực tế và phối hợp nhiều bot, như ví dụ đặt lịch khám bác sĩ. Kết luận: không có người thắng duy nhất, hãy chọn theo bộ công cụ và công việc của bạn.
t2579.fr: Réponse comparative du compte officiel Grok : OpenAI Dots dispose de son propre ordinateur cloud, de recherche proactive et de liens étroits avec ChatGPT, Slack, Teams et plus de 4 000 apps, avec un seul agent principal aujourd'hui. Grok Bot garde l'avantage sur certains appels téléphoniques réels et la coordination de plusieurs bots, comme l'exemple du rendez-vous médical. Verdict : pas de vainqueur unique, choisissez selon vos outils et la tâche.
t2579.es: Respuesta comparativa de la cuenta oficial de Grok: OpenAI Dots tiene su propio ordenador en la nube, investigación proactiva y conexión profunda con ChatGPT, Slack, Teams y más de 4.000 apps, con un agente principal por ahora. Grok Bot sigue por delante en algunos flujos de llamadas reales y coordinación entre varios bots, como el ejemplo de la cita médica. Veredicto: no hay un único ganador; elige según tus herramientas y la tarea.
t2579.de: Vergleichsantwort des offiziellen Grok-Kontos: OpenAI Dots hat einen eigenen Cloud-Rechner, proaktive Recherche und enge Anbindung an ChatGPT, Slack, Teams und über 4.000 Apps, derzeit mit einem Haupt-Agent. Grok Bot liegt bei manchen echten Telefon- und Multi-Bot-Abläufen weiter vorn, etwa beim Beispiel der Arzttermin-Buchung. Fazit: kein eindeutiger Sieger, wähle passend zu deinem Stack und der Aufgabe.

t2581.zh-CN: 作者统计：ChatGPT 应用目录 8,495 个、Claude 连接器目录 8,478 个，过去 7 天分别新增 1,020 和 708 个；Google 10 月 30 日上线的应用商店有 52 个，Meta Muse 只有 63 个。他认为这是类似早期应用商店的抢地盘，审核速度是护城河，开发者称 OpenAI 审核约 1–2 天。
t2581.zh-TW: 作者統計：ChatGPT 應用目錄 8,495 個、Claude 連接器目錄 8,478 個，過去 7 天分別新增 1,020 和 708 個；Google 10 月 30 日上線的應用商店有 52 個，Meta Muse 只有 63 個。他認為這是類似早期應用商店的搶地盤，審核速度是護城河，開發者稱 OpenAI 審核約 1–2 天。
t2581.en: The author counts 8,495 apps in ChatGPT's directory and 8,478 in Claude's connector directory, with 1,020 and 708 added in the last seven days. Google's store, opened October 30, has 52 and Meta Muse has 63. He sees an early app-store land grab where review speed is the moat; developers report OpenAI approvals in one to two days.
t2581.ja: 作者の集計では ChatGPT のアプリディレクトリが8,495、Claude のコネクタディレクトリが8,478で、直近7日でそれぞれ1,020と708増えた。10月30日に開いた Google のストアは52、Meta Muse は63。初期のアプリストアのような陣取り合戦で、審査の速さが堀になると見る。開発者によると OpenAI の承認は1〜2日。
t2581.ko: 작성자 집계로 ChatGPT 앱 디렉터리는 8,495개, Claude 커넥터 디렉터리는 8,478개이며 최근 7일간 각각 1,020개와 708개가 늘었다. 10월 30일 열린 Google 스토어는 52개, Meta Muse는 63개. 그는 초기 앱스토어 같은 영토 싸움이며 심사 속도가 해자라고 본다. 개발자들은 OpenAI 승인이 1~2일 걸린다고 한다.
t2581.ms: Penulis mengira 8,495 aplikasi dalam direktori ChatGPT dan 8,478 dalam direktori penyambung Claude, dengan 1,020 dan 708 ditambah dalam tujuh hari lepas. Kedai Google yang dibuka 30 Oktober ada 52 dan Meta Muse ada 63. Dia melihatnya sebagai perebutan wilayah seperti awal kedai aplikasi, dengan kelajuan semakan sebagai benteng; pembangun melaporkan kelulusan OpenAI dalam satu hingga dua hari.
t2581.vi: Tác giả đếm được 8.495 ứng dụng trong kho của ChatGPT và 8.478 trong kho connector của Claude, lần lượt thêm 1.020 và 708 trong bảy ngày qua. Cửa hàng của Google mở ngày 30/10 có 52, Meta Muse có 63. Anh cho rằng đây là cuộc chiếm đất như thời đầu của app store, và tốc độ duyệt là lợi thế; nhà phát triển cho biết OpenAI duyệt trong một đến hai ngày.
t2581.fr: L'auteur compte 8 495 apps dans l'annuaire de ChatGPT et 8 478 dans celui des connecteurs de Claude, avec 1 020 et 708 ajouts en sept jours. Le store de Google, ouvert le 30 octobre, en a 52 et Meta Muse 63. Il y voit une ruée comparable aux débuts des app stores, où la vitesse de validation fait la différence ; des développeurs parlent d'approbations OpenAI en un à deux jours.
t2581.es: El autor cuenta 8.495 apps en el directorio de ChatGPT y 8.478 en el de conectores de Claude, con 1.020 y 708 nuevas en los últimos siete días. La tienda de Google, abierta el 30 de octubre, tiene 52 y Meta Muse 63. Lo ve como una carrera por el territorio al estilo de las primeras tiendas de apps, donde la velocidad de revisión es la ventaja; desarrolladores hablan de aprobaciones de OpenAI en uno o dos días.
t2581.de: Der Autor zählt 8.495 Apps im ChatGPT-Verzeichnis und 8.478 im Connector-Verzeichnis von Claude, mit 1.020 bzw. 708 neuen in sieben Tagen. Googles am 30. Oktober eröffneter Store hat 52, Meta Muse 63. Er sieht einen Landraub wie in frühen App-Store-Jahren, bei dem die Prüfgeschwindigkeit den Ausschlag gibt; Entwickler berichten von OpenAI-Freigaben in ein bis zwei Tagen.

t2582.vi: Dots hay Grok Bot? Dots đến châu Âu khi hạn mức bị siết
t2582.fr: Dots ou Grok Bot ? Dots arrive en Europe au moment où les limites se resserrent
t2582.es: ¿Dots o Grok Bot? Dots llega a Europa mientras se endurecen los límites
t2582.de: Dots oder Grok Bot? Dots kommt nach Europa, während Limits enger werden

t2583.zh-CN: 作者把这周大家周额度见底归因于 Grok Bot 服务成本高于收入。他指出时机微妙：OpenAI Dots 即将进入欧洲，而且和 Dot 聊天不计入 ChatGPT 额度，很多人会去试，竞争会加剧。他目前认为 Grok Bot 领先很多，但预计 Dots 会进步很快。
t2583.zh-TW: 作者把這週大家週額度見底歸因於 Grok Bot 服務成本高於收入。他指出時機微妙：OpenAI Dots 即將進入歐洲，而且和 Dot 聊天不計入 ChatGPT 額度，很多人會去試，競爭會加劇。他目前認為 Grok Bot 領先很多，但預期 Dots 會進步很快。
t2583.en: The author links this week's melted weekly limits to Grok Bot costing more to serve than it earned. He notes the timing: OpenAI Dots is coming to Europe and chatting with your Dot doesn't count against ChatGPT limits, so many will try it and competition may heat up. For now he finds Grok Bot way ahead but expects Dots to improve fast.
t2583.ja: 著者は今週の週上限の急減を、Grok Bot の提供コストが収益を上回っていたためだと見る。タイミングも指摘する。OpenAI Dots が欧州に来て、Dot との会話は ChatGPT の上限に数えられないため、多くの人が試し競争が激しくなりそうだ。今は Grok Bot がかなり先行しているが、Dots はすぐ良くなると予想する。
t2583.ko: 작성자는 이번 주 주간 한도가 녹아내린 이유를 Grok Bot 제공 비용이 수익보다 컸기 때문으로 본다. 시점도 짚는다. OpenAI Dots가 유럽에 오고 Dot과의 대화는 ChatGPT 한도에 포함되지 않아 많은 사람이 써 볼 것이고 경쟁이 치열해질 수 있다. 지금은 Grok Bot이 훨씬 앞서지만 Dots도 빠르게 좋아질 것으로 본다.
t2583.ms: Penulis mengaitkan had mingguan yang cepat habis minggu ini dengan kos melayan Grok Bot yang melebihi hasilnya. Dia menyebut masanya: OpenAI Dots akan tiba di Eropah dan berbual dengan Dot tidak dikira dalam had ChatGPT, jadi ramai akan mencubanya dan persaingan mungkin memanas. Buat masa ini Grok Bot jauh di depan baginya, tetapi Dots dijangka cepat bertambah baik.
t2583.vi: Tác giả cho rằng hạn mức tuần cạn nhanh tuần này là do chi phí phục vụ Grok Bot cao hơn doanh thu. Anh lưu ý thời điểm: OpenAI Dots sắp đến châu Âu và trò chuyện với Dot không tính vào hạn mức ChatGPT, nên nhiều người sẽ thử và cạnh tranh có thể nóng lên. Hiện anh thấy Grok Bot vượt xa, nhưng dự đoán Dots sẽ tiến bộ nhanh.
t2583.fr: L'auteur relie les limites hebdomadaires vite épuisées cette semaine au fait que Grok Bot coûtait plus à servir qu'il ne rapportait. Il souligne le timing : OpenAI Dots arrive en Europe et discuter avec son Dot ne compte pas dans les limites de ChatGPT ; beaucoup vont essayer et la concurrence pourrait s'intensifier. Pour lui Grok Bot a encore une large avance, mais Dots progressera vite.
t2583.es: El autor atribuye los límites semanales agotados esta semana a que Grok Bot costaba más de servir de lo que ingresaba. Señala el momento: OpenAI Dots llega a Europa y hablar con tu Dot no cuenta para los límites de ChatGPT, así que muchos lo probarán y la competencia puede calentarse. Por ahora ve a Grok Bot muy por delante, pero espera que Dots mejore rápido.
t2583.de: Der Autor führt die diese Woche aufgebrauchten Wochenlimits darauf zurück, dass Grok Bot im Betrieb mehr kostete als einbrachte. Er verweist aufs Timing: OpenAI Dots kommt nach Europa, und Chats mit dem eigenen Dot zählen nicht gegen ChatGPT-Limits – viele werden es testen, der Wettbewerb könnte zunehmen. Aktuell sieht er Grok Bot weit vorn, erwartet aber schnelle Fortschritte bei Dots.

t2584.es: Entre GrokBot, Claude Max y ChatGPT Pro, eligió ChatGPT Pro
t2584.de: Zwischen GrokBot, Claude Max und ChatGPT Pro wählte er ChatGPT Pro

t2585.zh-CN: 作者比较后选了 100 美元的 ChatGPT Pro。理由：Dots 这个 always-on agent 还在探索，类似 GrokBot 但目前看不到多 bot；和 Dots 聊天不扣 ChatGPT/Codex 的周用量；没有 Claude Max 那样的 5 小时限额；每月 100 美元 API 额度；常遇到用量重置；订阅可用于 Hermes Agent；GPT-6.1 Sol 够用，但他也承认 Opus 5.5 很强。
t2585.zh-TW: 作者比較後選了 100 美元的 ChatGPT Pro。理由：Dots 這個 always-on agent 還在探索，類似 GrokBot 但目前看不到多 bot；和 Dots 聊天不扣 ChatGPT/Codex 的週用量；沒有 Claude Max 那種 5 小時限額；每月 100 美元 API 額度；常碰到用量重置；訂閱可用在 Hermes Agent；GPT-6.1 Sol 夠用，但他也承認 Opus 5.5 很強。
t2585.en: The author chose ChatGPT Pro at $100. His reasons: Dots, the always-on agent, is still exploratory and similar to GrokBot but doesn't seem to support multiple bots yet; chatting with Dots doesn't eat ChatGPT/Codex weekly usage; there's no 5-hour limit like Claude Max; $100 a month in API credits; frequent usage resets; the subscription works in Hermes Agent; and GPT-6.1 Sol is enough for him, though he admits Opus 5.5 is very good.
t2585.ja: 作者は100ドルの ChatGPT Pro を選んだ。理由は、always-on agent の Dots はまだ試行段階で GrokBot に似ているが複数 bot はまだ見当たらないこと、Dots との会話は ChatGPT/Codex の週間使用量を減らさないこと、Claude Max のような5時間制限がないこと、月100ドルの API クレジット、使用量リセットがよくあること、サブスクを Hermes Agent で使えること、GPT-6.1 Sol で足りること（ただし Opus 5.5 はとても良いと認めている）。
t2585.ko: 작성자는 100달러 ChatGPT Pro를 택했다. 이유는 다음과 같다. always-on agent인 Dots는 아직 탐색 단계로 GrokBot과 비슷하지만 다중 봇은 아직 안 보인다. Dots와 대화해도 ChatGPT/Codex 주간 사용량이 줄지 않는다. Claude Max 같은 5시간 제한이 없다. 매달 100달러 API 크레딧이 있다. 사용량 리셋이 자주 있다. 구독을 Hermes Agent에서 쓸 수 있다. GPT-6.1 Sol로 충분하지만 Opus 5.5가 아주 좋다는 점은 인정한다.
t2585.ms: Penulis memilih ChatGPT Pro 100 dolar. Sebabnya: Dots, ejen always-on, masih di peringkat penerokaan dan mirip GrokBot tetapi nampaknya belum menyokong banyak bot; berbual dengan Dots tidak memotong penggunaan mingguan ChatGPT/Codex; tiada had 5 jam seperti Claude Max; kredit API 100 dolar sebulan; kerap mendapat tetapan semula penggunaan; langganan boleh digunakan dalam Hermes Agent; dan GPT-6.1 Sol sudah memadai, walaupun dia akui Opus 5.5 sangat bagus.
t2585.vi: Tác giả chọn ChatGPT Pro giá 100 đô la. Lý do: Dots, agent luôn bật, vẫn đang thử nghiệm, giống GrokBot nhưng có vẻ chưa hỗ trợ nhiều bot; trò chuyện với Dots không trừ mức dùng hằng tuần của ChatGPT/Codex; không có giới hạn 5 giờ như Claude Max; 100 đô la tín dụng API mỗi tháng; thường được reset mức dùng; gói đăng ký dùng được trong Hermes Agent; và GPT-6.1 Sol là đủ, dù anh thừa nhận Opus 5.5 rất tốt.
t2585.fr: L'auteur a pris ChatGPT Pro à 100 $. Ses raisons : Dots, l'agent toujours actif, est encore exploratoire et proche de GrokBot sans sembler gérer plusieurs bots ; discuter avec Dots n'entame pas l'usage hebdomadaire de ChatGPT/Codex ; pas de limite de 5 heures comme Claude Max ; 100 $ de crédits API par mois ; des réinitialisations d'usage fréquentes ; l'abonnement fonctionne dans Hermes Agent ; et GPT-6.1 Sol lui suffit, même s'il reconnaît qu'Opus 5.5 est excellent.
t2585.es: El autor eligió ChatGPT Pro de 100 $. Sus motivos: Dots, el agente siempre activo, aún está en fase de exploración y se parece a GrokBot, pero no parece admitir varios bots; chatear con Dots no consume el uso semanal de ChatGPT/Codex; no hay límite de 5 horas como en Claude Max; 100 $ al mes en créditos de API; reinicios de uso frecuentes; la suscripción sirve en Hermes Agent; y GPT-6.1 Sol le basta, aunque admite que Opus 5.5 es muy bueno.
t2585.de: Der Autor nahm ChatGPT Pro für 100 $. Seine Gründe: Dots, der Always-on-Agent, ist noch im Erkundungsstadium und GrokBot ähnlich, scheint aber noch keine mehreren Bots zu unterstützen; Chats mit Dots zählen nicht zur Wochennutzung von ChatGPT/Codex; kein 5-Stunden-Limit wie bei Claude Max; 100 $ API-Guthaben im Monat; häufige Nutzungs-Resets; das Abo funktioniert in Hermes Agent; und GPT-6.1 Sol reicht ihm, auch wenn er Opus 5.5 für sehr gut hält.

t2587.zh-CN: 作者在开车途中测试不同 agent 能否处理一些轻量工作。在他的 Dot 和 Muse 之间，他对 Muse agent 在免费档上的表现感到惊讶；他说 Dot 也很好，同时提到 Dot 每月 150 美元。
t2587.zh-TW: 作者在開車途中測試不同 agent 能否處理一些輕量工作。在他的 Dot 和 Muse 之間，他對 Muse agent 在免費方案上的表現感到驚訝；他說 Dot 也很好，同時提到 Dot 每月 150 美元。
t2587.en: While driving, the author tested which agents could handle light work. Between his Dot and his Muse agent, he was shocked at how good Muse is even on the free tier; he says the Dot is great too, while noting it costs $150 a month.
t2587.ja: 作者は運転中に、どの agent が軽い仕事をこなせるか試した。Dot と Muse を比べ、無料プランでも Muse agent の出来の良さに驚いたという。Dot も良いとしつつ、月150ドルだと触れている。
t2587.ko: 작성자는 운전하면서 어떤 agent가 가벼운 일을 처리할 수 있는지 시험했다. Dot과 Muse 중 무료 플랜인데도 Muse agent가 훌륭해서 놀랐다고 한다. Dot도 좋다고 하면서 월 150달러라는 점을 짚었다.
t2587.ms: Semasa memandu, penulis menguji ejen mana yang boleh mengendalikan kerja ringan. Antara Dot dan ejen Muse miliknya, dia terkejut betapa bagusnya Muse walaupun pada peringkat percuma; katanya Dot juga hebat, sambil menyebut harganya 150 dolar sebulan.
t2587.vi: Khi lái xe, tác giả thử xem agent nào xử lý được việc nhẹ. Giữa Dot và Muse, anh bất ngờ vì Muse tốt dù chỉ ở gói miễn phí; anh nói Dot cũng tốt, đồng thời nhắc giá 150 đô la mỗi tháng.
t2587.fr: Au volant, l'auteur a testé quels agents pouvaient gérer de petites tâches. Entre son Dot et son agent Muse, il a été stupéfait de la qualité de Muse même en version gratuite ; il dit que le Dot est très bien aussi, tout en notant qu'il coûte 150 $ par mois.
t2587.es: Mientras conducía, el autor probó qué agentes podían con trabajo ligero. Entre su Dot y su agente Muse, le sorprendió lo bueno que es Muse incluso en el plan gratuito; dice que el Dot también es genial, aunque señala que cuesta 150 $ al mes.
t2587.de: Während der Fahrt testete der Autor, welche Agenten leichte Aufgaben erledigen können. Zwischen seinem Dot und seinem Muse-Agenten war er erstaunt, wie gut Muse schon in der Gratisstufe ist; Dot sei auch gut, koste aber 150 $ im Monat.

t2589.zh-CN: 作者订了 3 个 Claude Max、500 美元 Codex 和最高档 Grok Bot。排名：ChatGPT Dots 第一，语音通话最强；Grok Bot 第二，本可第一，但用量额度太紧，每周流程得迁就它；第三是 Claude Duet。
t2589.zh-TW: 作者訂了 3 個 Claude Max、500 美元 Codex 和最高檔 Grok Bot。排名：ChatGPT Dots 第一，語音通話最強；Grok Bot 第二，本可第一，但用量額度太緊，每週流程得遷就它；第三是 Claude Duet。
t2589.en: With 3 Claude Max plans, a $500 Codex plan and a max Grok Bot plan, the author ranks: 1) ChatGPT Dots for elite voice calling, 2) Grok Bot, which would be first but its usage limits force weekly workflows to adapt, 3) Claude Duet.
t2589.ja: Claude Max 3 つ、500 ドルの Codex、最上位の Grok Bot を契約する作者の順位：1 位 ChatGPT Dots（音声通話が抜群）、2 位 Grok Bot（本来 1 位だが使用量上限が厳しく週のワークフローを合わせる必要あり）、3 位 Claude Duet。
t2589.ko: Claude Max 3개, 500달러 Codex, 최상위 Grok Bot을 쓰는 작성자의 순위: 1위 ChatGPT Dots(음성 통화가 탁월), 2위 Grok Bot(1위감이지만 사용량 한도가 빡빡해 주간 워크플로를 맞춰야 함), 3위 Claude Duet.
t2589.ms: Dengan 3 pelan Claude Max, pelan Codex USD500 dan pelan Grok Bot tertinggi, penulis menyusun: 1) ChatGPT Dots, panggilan suara terbaik; 2) Grok Bot, sepatutnya pertama tetapi had penggunaan memaksa aliran kerja mingguan menyesuaikan diri; 3) Claude Duet.
t2589.vi: Với 3 gói Claude Max, gói Codex 500 USD và gói Grok Bot cao nhất, tác giả xếp: 1) ChatGPT Dots, gọi thoại xuất sắc; 2) Grok Bot, lẽ ra đứng đầu nhưng hạn mức sử dụng buộc phải điều chỉnh quy trình hằng tuần; 3) Claude Duet.
t2589.fr: Avec 3 abonnements Claude Max, un plan Codex à 500 $ et le plan Grok Bot maximal, l'auteur classe : 1) ChatGPT Dots, pour ses appels vocaux, 2) Grok Bot, qui serait premier sans ses limites d'usage qui obligent à adapter les workflows hebdomadaires, 3) Claude Duet.
t2589.es: Con 3 planes Claude Max, un plan Codex de 500 $ y el plan máximo de Grok Bot, el autor ordena: 1) ChatGPT Dots, por sus llamadas de voz; 2) Grok Bot, que sería el primero si sus límites de uso no le obligaran a adaptar sus flujos semanales; 3) Claude Duet.
t2589.de: Mit 3 Claude-Max-Abos, einem 500-Dollar-Codex-Plan und dem größten Grok-Bot-Plan sortiert der Autor: 1) ChatGPT Dots wegen der Sprachanrufe, 2) Grok Bot, eigentlich Platz 1, aber die Nutzungslimits zwingen zu angepassten Wochenabläufen, 3) Claude Duet.

t2591.zh-CN: 作者喜欢 Dots「编排多个会话」的思路，但觉得 Grok Bot 更像一支已经在干活的团队，而不是一个聊天窗口驱动标签页。下一步想让 Bot 在各自的虚拟机上跑 Claude Code。
t2591.zh-TW: 作者喜歡 Dots「編排多個工作階段」的思路，但覺得 Grok Bot 更像一支已在工作的團隊，而不是一個聊天視窗驅動分頁。下一步想讓 Bot 在各自的虛擬機上跑 Claude Code。
t2591.en: The author liked Dots' idea of an orchestrator of sessions, but says Grok Bot feels more like a team already working than one chat driving tabs. Next they want bots running Claude Code on their own VMs.
t2591.ja: 作者は Dots の「セッションを指揮する」発想を気に入ったが、Grok Bot は一つのチャットがタブを動かすより、すでに働いているチームに近いと感じた。次は各 Bot が自分の VM で Claude Code を動かす構成を考えている。
t2591.ko: 작성자는 세션을 지휘하는 Dots의 발상이 좋았지만, Grok Bot은 하나의 채팅이 탭을 움직이는 것보다 이미 일하고 있는 팀에 가깝다고 느꼈다. 다음에는 봇마다 자체 VM에서 Claude Code를 돌리고 싶어 한다.
t2591.ms: Penulis suka idea Dots sebagai pengatur sesi, tetapi merasakan Grok Bot lebih seperti pasukan yang sudah bekerja berbanding satu sembang yang mengawal tab. Seterusnya dia mahu bot menjalankan Claude Code pada VM masing-masing.
t2591.vi: Tác giả thích ý tưởng điều phối phiên làm việc của Dots, nhưng thấy Grok Bot giống một đội đang làm việc hơn là một khung chat điều khiển các tab. Bước tiếp theo, họ muốn các bot chạy Claude Code trên VM riêng.
t2591.fr: L'auteur a aimé l'idée d'orchestrateur de sessions de Dots, mais trouve que Grok Bot ressemble davantage à une équipe déjà au travail qu'à un chat qui pilote des onglets. Prochaine étape : des bots exécutant Claude Code sur leurs propres VM.
t2591.es: Al autor le gustó la idea de Dots como orquestador de sesiones, pero siente que Grok Bot se parece más a un equipo ya trabajando que a un chat moviendo pestañas. Lo siguiente: bots ejecutando Claude Code en sus propias VM.
t2591.de: Dem Autor gefiel die Idee von Dots als Orchestrator von Sitzungen, doch Grok Bot wirkt eher wie ein bereits arbeitendes Team als ein Chat, der Tabs steuert. Als Nächstes sollen Bots Claude Code auf eigenen VMs ausführen.

t2593.zh-CN: 作者让 Dot 做了一个 YouTube 视频，然后发去一份完整的审查意见。Dot 回复“要开始返工吗？”，30 分钟后仍在等待，又问“要暂停这个例行任务吗？”（德语，作者翻译）。作者说 Grok Bot 在他说做得不好时会直接返工。
t2593.zh-TW: 作者讓 Dot 做了一支 YouTube 影片，然後傳去一份完整的審查意見。Dot 回覆「要開始重做嗎？」，30 分鐘後仍在等待，又問「要暫停這個例行任務嗎？」（德文，作者翻譯）。作者說 Grok Bot 在他說做得不好時會直接重做。
t2593.en: The author had Dot make a YouTube video and sent it a full audit. Dot replied 'should I start the rework?' and, 30 minutes later, was still waiting and asked 'should I pause the routine?' (in German, translated by the author). He says Grok Bot simply reworks it when he says it's bad.
t2593.ja: 作者は Dot に YouTube 動画を作らせ、詳細な監査コメントを送りました。Dot は「作り直しを始めますか？」と返し、30分後もまだ待っていて「ルーティンを一時停止しますか？」と尋ねたそうです（ドイツ語、作者訳）。Grok Bot はダメだと言えばそのまま作り直すと作者は述べています。
t2593.ko: 작성자는 Dot에게 YouTube 영상을 만들게 한 뒤 전체 검토 의견을 보냈습니다. Dot은 '재작업을 시작할까요?'라고 답했고, 30분 뒤에도 여전히 기다리며 '루틴을 일시 중지할까요?'라고 물었습니다(독일어, 작성자 번역). 작성자는 Grok Bot은 별로라고 말하면 그냥 다시 작업한다고 말합니다.
t2593.ms: Penulis menyuruh Dot membuat video YouTube dan menghantar audit penuh. Dot membalas 'patutkah saya mulakan kerja semula?' dan 30 minit kemudian masih menunggu sambil bertanya 'patutkah saya jeda rutin?' (dalam bahasa Jerman, diterjemah penulis). Katanya Grok Bot terus membuat semula apabila dia kata hasilnya teruk.
t2593.vi: Tác giả nhờ Dot làm một video YouTube rồi gửi bản đánh giá đầy đủ. Dot trả lời 'có nên bắt đầu làm lại không?', 30 phút sau vẫn chờ và hỏi 'có nên tạm dừng routine không?' (tiếng Đức, tác giả dịch). Anh nói Grok Bot thì cứ làm lại khi anh bảo kết quả tệ.
t2593.fr: L'auteur a demandé à Dot une vidéo YouTube puis lui a envoyé un audit complet. Dot a répondu « dois-je commencer la reprise ? » et, 30 minutes plus tard, attendait toujours en demandant « dois-je mettre la routine en pause ? » (en allemand, traduit par l'auteur). Selon lui, Grok Bot refait simplement le travail quand il dit que c'est mauvais.
t2593.es: El autor pidió a Dot un vídeo de YouTube y le envió una auditoría completa. Dot respondió «¿empiezo a rehacerlo?» y 30 minutos después seguía esperando y preguntó «¿pauso la rutina?» (en alemán, traducido por el autor). Dice que Grok Bot simplemente lo rehace cuando le dice que está mal.
t2593.de: Der Autor ließ Dot ein YouTube-Video erstellen und schickte ein vollständiges Audit. Dot antwortete „Soll ich mit der Überarbeitung beginnen?“ und fragte 30 Minuten später, noch wartend, „Soll ich die Routine pausieren?“. Grok Bot überarbeite einfach, wenn er sage, dass es schlecht ist.

t2595.zh-CN: 作者查阅了 Muse、dots、Cue、Grok Bot、Today 的价格页和公开评测（10 月 30 日复核），结论是功能已趋同，差别在入口、能否进入封闭平台和信任。附对照表和 48 条来源。作者声明利益相关：自己在用 Grok Bot。
t2595.zh-TW: 作者查閱了 Muse、dots、Cue、Grok Bot、Today 的價格頁和公開評測（10 月 30 日複核），結論是功能已趨同，差別在入口、能否進入封閉平台和信任。附對照表和 48 條來源。作者聲明利益相關：自己在用 Grok Bot。
t2595.en: The author went through the pricing pages and public reviews of Muse, dots, Cue, Grok Bot and Today (rechecked on Oct 30) and concludes the features have converged; the differences are in entry points, access to closed platforms, and trust. A comparison table and 48 sources are attached. Disclosure: the author uses Grok Bot.
t2595.ja: 作者は Muse、dots、Cue、Grok Bot、Today の料金ページと公開レビューを確認（10月30日に再確認）。機能はほぼ横並びで、違いは入口、閉じたプラットフォームに入れるか、そして信頼だと結論づけています。比較表と48件の出典付き。利害関係として、作者自身は Grok Bot を使っていると明記しています。
t2595.ko: 작성자는 Muse, dots, Cue, Grok Bot, Today의 가격 페이지와 공개 리뷰를 살펴보고(10월 30일 재확인) 기능은 이미 비슷해졌고 차이는 진입점, 폐쇄형 플랫폼 접근 여부, 신뢰에 있다고 결론 내렸습니다. 비교표와 출처 48개가 첨부되어 있습니다. 이해관계 공개: 작성자는 Grok Bot을 사용합니다.
t2595.ms: Penulis meneliti halaman harga dan ulasan awam Muse, dots, Cue, Grok Bot dan Today (disemak semula pada 30 Okt) dan menyimpulkan ciri-cirinya sudah hampir sama; perbezaannya pada titik masuk, akses ke platform tertutup dan kepercayaan. Disertakan jadual perbandingan dan 48 sumber. Pendedahan: penulis menggunakan Grok Bot.
t2595.vi: Tác giả xem trang giá và các đánh giá công khai của Muse, dots, Cue, Grok Bot và Today (kiểm tra lại ngày 30/10) và kết luận tính năng đã gần như giống nhau; khác biệt nằm ở điểm truy cập, khả năng vào các nền tảng đóng và độ tin cậy. Kèm bảng so sánh và 48 nguồn. Công khai lợi ích: tác giả đang dùng Grok Bot.
t2595.fr: L'auteur a passé en revue les pages tarifaires et les tests publics de Muse, dots, Cue, Grok Bot et Today (revérifiés le 30 octobre) : les fonctions ont convergé, les différences tiennent au point d'entrée, à l'accès aux plateformes fermées et à la confiance. Tableau comparatif et 48 sources joints. Conflit d'intérêts déclaré : l'auteur utilise Grok Bot.
t2595.es: El autor revisó las páginas de precios y las reseñas públicas de Muse, dots, Cue, Grok Bot y Today (verificadas de nuevo el 30 de octubre) y concluye que las funciones ya convergen; las diferencias están en el punto de entrada, el acceso a plataformas cerradas y la confianza. Incluye tabla comparativa y 48 fuentes. Aviso: el autor usa Grok Bot.
t2595.de: Der Autor hat Preisseiten und öffentliche Tests von Muse, dots, Cue, Grok Bot und Today durchgesehen (am 30. Oktober erneut geprüft): Die Funktionen haben sich angeglichen, Unterschiede liegen beim Einstiegspunkt, beim Zugang zu geschlossenen Plattformen und beim Vertrauen. Vergleichstabelle und 48 Quellen anbei. Offenlegung: Der Autor nutzt Grok Bot.
